_doc: Marian advocations and other female devotional titles. Almost every entry is also a common woman's given name, and that collision is the analytic heart of the thesis: a Calle Carmen may honour the Virgen del Carmen or a woman called Carmen, and the two readings carry opposite meanings for how visible women are in the city. The classifier therefore never resolves the collision silently -- it records both readings and flags the name as contested unless the thesis or an explicit devotional word settles it.
